capabilities.name: Governed Insurance Terminology Resolution
capabilities.responsibility: Represent insurer-neutral canonical insurance concepts, governed insurer/product terminology and exact aliases in immutable registry snapshots; resolve only explicit exact governed mappings; and hand a resolved canonical concept downstream as a bounded planning hint without inferring applicability or advisory meaning.
capabilities.authority_role: Terminology-normalization and mapping authority only. It may identify an exact governed concept/term relationship, but it does not establish product applicability, retrieve evidence, interpret policy clauses, compare products, rank options, assess suitability, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Exact governed matches are required; fuzzy matching, token similarity, semantic inference and LLM-originated terminology resolution are excluded from this capability.
Ambiguous, inactive, unpublished, unreviewed or missing mappings remain unresolved rather than being guessed.
Canonical concepts remain insurer-neutral and are distinct from insurer marketing terms and product-specific implementations.

A READY terminology-to-planner handoff is only a planning hint and never asserts downstream capability availability, product applicability, evidence sufficiency, comparison meaning or recommendation authority.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the pre-existing MO-024 terminology subsystem (canonical concepts, immutable registry, exact resolver, governed aliases, health/product seeds and bounded planner handoff). Registration does not claim that terminology resolution establishes policy truth or recommendation authority.
